name_reason: Matches fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. The '10' is the dispatch-table index 0x10, a domain ID (verified: table base 0x51B91 + 0x10*4 = 0x51BD1 = the sole xref source via read_memory -> 0x00034696 LE), not a Ghidra address residue. The '__ch5_dialog' suffix correctly states the chapter (5) and category (dialog-only beat) matching the body (portrait set 3 reload + dialog page 5). No address residue.
purpose: Chapter 5 turn-event slot 2 (turn 7 / phase 0): a dialog-only beat that reloads portrait set 3 and shows chapter dialog page 5.
logic_summary: Straight-line, no-branch handler. Calls fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(3) to swap to portrait set 3, then fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, page=5, 0xA0000, 0x140, 0xCD, 0x4C, 0x4A, 0x13, 1) to render dialog page 5 with the fixed dialog geometry. event_arg is never read. No RNG, no numeric computation, no CALL-return value used. In the original binary the trailing dialog call is reached by preparing the 8 PUSHes then JMP 0x3452F into handler_09's shared tail (PUSH data_fd2_current_chapter_text; CALL fd2_display_dialog_scene; ADD ESP,0x24; RET); the src reproduces it as the inline call for Layer-2 equivalence.

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: Uniform 1-arg cdecl argument of the per-event handler table at 0x51B91; never read by this turn-event handler (cast to void). Same name and convention as all sibling handlers in the table.
params.reason: Descriptive, matches the uniform dispatch-table arg convention shared by all sibling handlers; no address residue; accurately reflects that the value is the (unused) dispatch argument.

returns.semantics: No return value; side effects only (portrait set swap + dialog render). fd2_display_dialog_scene's return is discarded.
